title: TDS: Support SPNEGO
description:
Microsoft SQL Server uses SPNEGO in both 4.2 [MS-SSTDS] and 7.x and 8.0
[MS-TDS] versions of TDS. FreeTDS uses a different GSS-API
implementation. Check for both when dissecting SSPI packets and tokens.

Fix #19073
